title: CSV to JSON Converter
subtitle: Convert CSV files to JSON format
description: Convert CSV files to JSON format for APIs, databases, and web applications. Supports custom delimiters and header mapping.

features.title: Custom Delimiters
features.description: Support comma, semicolon, tab, and custom delimiters

features.title: Header Mapping
features.description: Map CSV headers to JSON property names

tips: First row is used as headers by default
Numbers are preserved as numbers, not strings
Large files may take time to process
